Your information, explained

Privacy Policy

This policy explains how information is handled when you play KickStorm, use online multiplayer, view advertisements, or contact us.

Effective date: 6 November 2026 · Android app: com.nemax.worldcup.fifacup

KickStorm is a football game from NEMAX. In this policy, “we” refers to the developer of KickStorm. For privacy questions or requests, contact megaunit21@gmail.com.

At a glance

KickStorm does not require an account to play. Game settings and progress are saved on your device. Online multiplayer and Google AdMob advertising involve third-party services that process connection, device, and usage information. The game is intended for players aged 14 and older.

Information handledHow it is usedThird-party servicesYour choicesRetention & securityYoung playersContact & requests

1. Information handled by the game

  • Local game information. Settings, gameplay progress, scores, preferences, and ad-related preferences or reward status can be stored on your device. Clearing game storage or uninstalling the app can remove this local information.
  • Multiplayer information. When you use online play, the game creates a random game-instance identifier and sends information needed to connect players and run a match. This can include your IP address, connection information, room or match identifiers, and gameplay actions and state. Some match information is visible to other players in that match. A private room code controls who can join; it should not be treated as a confidential account password.
  • Advertising information. Google AdMob and its advertising services process information such as IP address (which can indicate approximate location), device and advertising identifiers, app or ad interactions, and diagnostic or performance information. Processing depends on service configuration, your device settings, your location, and any applicable consent choices.
  • Technical information. The game is built with Unity and uses related software services. These services may process device, app-version, diagnostic, or service-usage information as described in their privacy notices and according to the features in use.
  • Information you send us. If you email support, we receive your email address and the information you choose to include. Please do not send passwords, payment-card details, or other unnecessary sensitive information.

2. How information is used and shared

Information is used to operate and maintain the game; save your settings; connect players and synchronize multiplayer matches; deliver and measure advertisements; diagnose performance problems; help prevent fraud or misuse; and answer support and privacy requests.

Information is processed by service providers where needed for these functions. Multiplayer data is also exchanged with the other players participating in a match. Ad-related information may be shared within Google's advertising services and with advertising partners, subject to the relevant service settings and privacy choices. Information may also be disclosed where required by applicable law.

Service providers may process information in countries other than your country of residence.

3. Third-party services

The following providers have their own privacy notices and data-handling practices:

  • Google AdMob / Google Mobile Ads: advertising, ad measurement, fraud prevention, and advertising consent. Google Privacy Policy · How Google uses information from apps that use its services.
  • Photon Engine: online connections, matchmaking, rooms, and multiplayer message delivery. Photon Privacy and Cookie Policy.
  • Unity: game-engine and related service operation and diagnostics. Unity Privacy Policy.

Opening third-party links takes you to a service governed by its own privacy notice.

4. Your choices

  • Advertising consent: where required, the game requests advertising consent through Google's consent system. Where available, use the game's privacy-options control to revisit your choices. Ad availability and personalization depend on applicable consent and service settings.
  • Device advertising controls: Android provides settings to reset or delete your advertising ID and manage advertising preferences. Available controls vary by Android version.
  • Online play: multiplayer requires a network connection. You can leave an online session or choose offline game modes instead.
  • Local storage: you can clear the game's storage through Android settings or uninstall the game. This may erase progress and preferences; it does not automatically delete information already held by third-party providers.
  • Privacy requests: contact us using the address below to ask about access, correction, deletion, or other rights available under applicable law. We may need information to identify the relevant data and verify the request.

5. Retention and security

Local information remains on your device until it is changed or removed. Support correspondence is retained as needed to respond to requests and address applicable legal or operational obligations. Information held by third-party providers is subject to their retention practices, notices, and available deletion mechanisms.

We use reasonable safeguards appropriate to the information and services involved. Google states that information collected by its Mobile Ads SDK is encrypted in transit. This does not mean that every gameplay message uses the same protection. No system can guarantee absolute security.

6. Young players

KickStorm is intended for players aged 14 and older and is not directed at children under 14. This statement describes the intended audience; it is not a claim that the game verifies every player's age. If you believe a child has provided personal information to us, please contact us so we can assess the request and take appropriate action.

7. Contact and policy updates

We may update this policy when the game or its services change. The effective date above identifies the current published version.
